officialSources.observation: Official district portal; its service navigation links state revenue/land-record and mapping resources.
Official Uttar Pradesh cadastral map viewer shell. Downloaded bundle declares base URL https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver.
Anonymous selector labels are District, Tehsil, Village.
Viewer resolves state code 09, Uttar Pradesh.
District selector returned Meerut with code 138.
Meerut tehsil selector returned Sadar (00734), Mawana and Sardhana.
Sadar village selector returned 45,348 bytes of selector JSON; multiple entries flag map data. No parcel feature response was requested.

Official UP Bhulekh report for district 138 and Meerut Sadar (tehsil code 00734) lists revenue village मेरठ (code 219037); Village Khatauni, scanned, verified and BhuNaksha-linked flags are 1, village georeference flag is 0, and 8 mapsheets are scanned/verified. This is an index/processing status, not a geometry response.

BhuNaksha map-info request at Meerut district and Sadar tehsil selection failed. The internal GIS-code creation request returned HTTP 403, so no valid selected map extent was produced; no point identify was attempted without an extent, village code, and verified coordinate reference.

observedClientRoutes: POST /MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref (selection-level map extent; failed before village map selection)

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: The official UP Bhulekh dashboard narrows the local match to Sadar revenue village मेरठ (219037), with eight scanned/verified mapsheets and the Bhunaksha link flag set. Village georeference and mapsheet georeference flags are zero. The public viewer’s two-level map-info request failed before a valid map extent was returned; the WUP point was not passed as pixel/map XY to getPlotAtXY, and no parcel geometry was retrieved.

threeLevelMapInfoRequest.outcome: Official village selection resolved, but no usable map extent; point identify not attempted.
